year_notes: Britannica gives earl of Cornwall 1227, others 1225.

year_notes: Birth c. 1186 or c. 1188. She married King John in August 1200, so the role starts before 1201.

year_notes: Birth estimate. Year 1206 is an estimate of his entry into John's service.
life: He was a Norman soldier who rose in King John's service. He held Bedford Castle and fought for the young king. He fell from power after the siege of Bedford in 1224.

name_en: Simon de Montfort, Earl of Leicester
year_notes: Birth c. 1208. Britannica student text gives arrival in England 1229. Earl formally in 1239.

wiki_title: Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester

year_notes: Birth 1175 with a question mark. Catholic Encyclopedia c. 1180. Wikipedia c. 1174.

year_notes: Birth c. 1168. He taught at Oxford before 1235. The game year is his election as bishop.

year_notes: Birth c. 1200, estimate. Monk from 1217. Year 1236 is the start of his chronicle work, from memory.

year_notes: Death 24 or 25 June 1291.
life: She was a daughter of the count of Provence. She married Henry III in 1236. She was regent in 1253 and was unpopular with the barons.

year_notes: Birth c. 1181. Wikipedia gives death 1233. The 1911 Britannica gives 1236.
life: He was a baron of Poitou and a troubadour. He fought for Arthur, then John freed him and made him seneschal of Poitou. He changed sides more than one time.

year_notes: Birth c. 1170. He served John from about 1205 to 1212, then France.
life: He was a monk who became a pirate captain. He raided for King John, then went over to Philip II in 1212. The English took and beheaded him at Sandwich in 1217.

year_notes: Death place Millau or Toulouse. Year 1216 is the siege of Beaucaire, from memory.

year_notes: Birth c. 1195. Year 1209 is an estimate. He married in 1208.
life: He fought beside his father against the crusaders. He became count of Foix in 1223. He made peace with the French crown in 1229.

year_notes: Birth 1204 or 1207. Death 1263 or later. Year 1224 is his return to Carcassonne, estimate.
life: He was the son of the viscount who died in 1209. He won back Carcassonne for a time and besieged it again in 1240. He gave up his rights to Louis IX in 1247.

year_notes: Birth c. 1180. Death c. 1278. Both are approximate.
life: He came from a noble family of Le Puy. He worked as a scribe for Raymond VI from 1204. He wrote sharp satires against the clergy and the crusaders.

year_notes: Birth 1200, approximate. He changed sides in later life.
life: He was the son of the lord of Termes who fought Simon de Montfort. He resisted the French for years. He later served Louis IX and fought on crusade.

year_notes: Reign from 1213 in Wikipedia, 1214 in Britannica. Some give birth 1207.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map

year_notes: Birth 1198 or 1195. Often numbered IV.

year_notes: Birth 1189, or 1182. Death 1256, one entry 1259. Death place Barcelona or Valencia.

year_notes: Britannica gives birth c. 1185. Wikipedia gives c. 1175.
life: He was a Dominican and a master of church law. He compiled the Decretals of Gregory IX in 1234. He led the Dominicans from 1238.

year_notes: Birth 1185 from one source only, estimate. Béarn from 1223 or 1224.

name_en: Peter of Portugal, Lord of Majorca
life: He was a son of Sancho I of Portugal who went into exile. He became count of Urgell by marriage in 1229. He traded Urgell for Majorca and ruled the islands until his death.

year_notes: Birth unknown, estimate.

year_notes: Birth c. 1170, death c. 1250. Year 1220 is an estimate.

year_notes: Birth 29 September or 29 November 1189.

year_notes: Birth unknown, estimate. Death 1240, one version 1239.

year_notes: Birth c. 1170.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map

year_notes: Birthplace Burgos or Toledo. Year 1243 is Murcia, from memory, not checked.

year_notes: Birth c. 1198, others c. 1195 or c. 1197. Year 1221 is an estimate.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map
life: He was a priest at the monastery of San Millan. He was the first named poet in Castilian. He wrote lives of saints and miracles of the Virgin.

year_notes: Birth 1205 in most sources. Others give 1198 to 1203.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map

year_notes: Birth unknown, estimate. Chancery from 1211 or 1217.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map

year_notes: Some give birth 1203 or 1204. Year 1236 is Cordoba.

year_notes: Birth unknown, estimate. Chronicle done 1236 or c. 1238.

year_notes: Birth 1191 or 1192. Death year 1243 is an estimate, not checked.

year_notes: Birth c. 1195. Death year 1248 is an estimate, not checked.

year_notes: Birth c. 1192 or 1193.

year_notes: Count of Boulogne from 1238. Regent of Portugal from 1245.

year_notes: Birth c. 1215, others 1205 to 1220. Year 1245 is an estimate. Scholars dispute that he wrote the Summulae.
life: He was born in Lisbon and studied medicine and logic. He taught and wrote on medicine. He became pope in 1276.

year_notes: Birth c. 1205, estimate. Death January or 8 February 1275.

year_notes: Birth c. 1195, others up to c. 1200.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map
life: She was a daughter of Sancho I. She married the boy king Henry I of Castile in 1215. After the annulment she became a nun at Arouca.

life: He was a son of Sancho I of Portugal. He became count of Flanders by marriage to Joan in 1212. The French took him at Bouvines and held him in the Louvre.

life: He was the younger brother of Baldwin IX. He ruled at home while Baldwin was on crusade. He had custody of Baldwin's daughters.

year_notes: Birth c. 1199. Marriage 1236 or 1237.

year_notes: Birth c. 1218.

year_notes: Birth c. 1186.; europe city is a stand-in: the first city of the faction on that map

year_notes: Birth 1185 or 1186.

life: He became Landgrave of Thuringia in 1217 and married Elizabeth of Hungary. He took the cross with Frederick II. He died of fever at Otranto in 1227 before the fleet sailed.

life: He was the son of William of Winchester and the heir of the Welf lands. Otto IV was his guardian. In 1235 Frederick II made him the first Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg.

year_notes: Birth c.1190 (one genealogy gives 1188).
